{{Quote|According to the Archive Report, a captured Jilruan pirate told the authorities on Belasco of the planned raid on Parcovey Minor.|Albegron mentions the pirate|<ref name="EGTWAC" />}}
A [[Jilruan/Legends|Jilruan]] '''pirate''' was held captive by authorities on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belasco/Legends|Belasco]] during the [[Kymoodon Era]]. The pirate revealed to the authorities while in captivity that there was an [[Assault on Parcovey Minor|assault]] being planned on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Parcovey Minor]]. The tip off allowed the [[Belasco Free Volunteers]] to rush to the planet's defense and defeat the raid which was backed by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Utoradii]] kajidic. The Jilruan's role in revealing the assault was recorded in a report which was then stored in a [[Kymoodon-era government archive|government archive]] on Belasco. The report would later be rediscovered in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], leading [[Thunys Albegron]], an Academician of Popular Studies, to mention the Jilruan at the [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] [[Conference on Popular Entertainment]].<ref name="EGTWAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jilruan was first mentioned in the [[2014]] fifth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'' series of posts by [[Jason Fry]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]]. The article featured content cut from ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' a book released in [[2012]] by Fry. The article did not clarify the Jilruan's [[Gender/Legends|gender]] or name.
